Usage: `lakana project-version [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Immutable project versions.

## `lakana project-version show`

Usage: `lakana project-version show [OPTIONS] {project_version_id}`

Show project version ID: its assets, the package indexes its lock uses and the DAG as a tree.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PROJECT_VERSION_ID` | text | required |  |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
